description: Scaffolds one component for an existing table: a custom cell, the element of the row details, or the filters of the Filter Drawer, and tells how to connect it to the page: the registration of the element and its column, or the container of the drawer. For a new table use generate_code, which writes its cells too. Example: {"kind": "cell", "target": "angular", "skin": "mat", "rowType": "Order", "fields": [{"name": "status", "type": "string"}], "name": "status", "shows": "the status as a chip", "reads": ["status"]}

actions.description: For a cell: the actions that it sends in its output action, as edit; the table gives them to the page as bro-action with the column and the row

fields.description: The fields of the row: name, type (string, number, boolean or string[]) and, for a string field, its values

filling.description: For a cell or the details, the code that you write: {imports, template, styles, members} for an Angular project, {render, members} for Vanilla JS; get_docs, topic fillings

imports.description: Angular: the components of the project that the template uses; the classes of Angular Material and the pipes of Angular come from the template

from.description: The path of the module, as ./order-badge

anyOf.description: The name of a class of Angular Material or of a pipe of Angular, as DatePipe

members.description: The members of the class: computed values, handlers

render.description: Vanilla JS: the body of render(), which builds the DOM of the cell

styles.description: Angular: the styles of the component

template.description: Angular: the template of the component, in every skin

filters.description: For filters: the filters of the Filter Drawer, in the form of filters of a spec; get_docs, topic filters

field.description: The field of the row the filter compares

match.description: text: contains or startsWith; select and checkbox: eq; range compares itself

name.description: The key in the object of the filters; a range has the keys <name>From and <name>To

rule.description: The rule of the match custom, in words

kind.description: What to scaffold: cell, a custom cell of a column; details, the element of the row details; filters, the filters of the Filter Drawer

name.description: For a cell or the details: its name in kebab-case, as status; the tag of the element is bro-cell-<row-type>-<name>

reads.description: For a cell or the details: the names of the fields of the row that it reads

rowType.description: The name of the type of a row in PascalCase, as Order

shows.description: For a cell or the details: what it shows, in words, as the status as a chip

skin.description: The skin, the UI library the table works on top of: mat (Angular Material), bs (Bootstrap 5) or nv (native HTML, no library)

target.description: The target: angular for an Angular project, through the wrapper <table-bro-ng>; vanilla for a page without a framework, the Custom Element <table-bro> itself

name: scaffold_component
title: Scaffold a component of a table
